releaseNotes.zh: Replace hand-drawn geometric icons with 29 verbatim official brand SVGs (@lobehub/icons + simple-icons, including dedicated Google Antigravity icon), add pure-Swift W3C SVG renderer, and support dynamic plugin iconSvg delivery across Mac Agent, iOS, Widgets, and Apple Watch.
